notes: Fresh immutable worker pool processed first: jobs 80 raw and industry 100 raw. Cheap global name de-dup was applied across workers and own discovery before deep-check; final physical dedup is delegated to the integration guard immediately before write. Own discovery then added 120 non-overlapping source-level identities across six 20-record low-overlap catalog lanes, bringing the run to 300 raw. These 300 are not claimed as 300 fully legal-key-resolved companies because early rejects were intentionally stopped before LEGAL resolution. Criteria were not relaxed. RuDesktop was independently rechecked against current public sources; the worker-stated vacancy publication date was not independently confirmed and is therefore excluded from the canonical claim. No outreach was performed.
